mapper.select: select * from mg_student where student_code = #{studentCode} and is_deleted = 0
select * from mg_student where sys_user_id = #{sysUserId} and is_deleted = 0

SELECT s.id, s.student_code, s.real_name, s.birth_date, s.admission_year, s.major, s.academic_status, s.description, s.sys_user_id, s.create_time, s.update_time, u.avatar, u.username, u.nick_name, u.email, u.mobile, u.gender, u.status FROM mg_student s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON s.sys_user_id = u.id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.create_time DESC
